title: Listening to Fats Waller, Jelly Roll Morton and Willie the Lion
summary: In Pittsburgh she studied Fats Waller, Jelly Roll Morton and Willie the Lion records; Morton later corrected her version of 'Pearls' in New York.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Earlier you mentioned about your listening to Fats Waller records. What else were you listening to?

Jelly Roll Morton and Willie the Lion. I didn't get many of his records. I had copies of Jelly Roll's records. I happened to go to New York one time and I was playing his 'Pearls' and he, you know how he was, a little irritable and he said, "You don't play it like that! You play it like this!" And then he showed me how he wanted me to play it.
But back in an earlier stage in Pittsburgh you were listening to Waller and to Jelly Roll and to Willie the Lion?
Jelly Johnson's rolls for the set player.
